thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO ALERT: streaming-api (eu-west-1) p99 > 5s for the last 6m. Auto-paging triggered — paging on-call. Link: https://incidents.example/5346789012
Maya: seeing a big jump in tail latency starting ~5346787000. p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 5.8s, error rate slightly up (0.6%). Chunk gaps in SSE streams, many clients reporting stall mid-stream.
Liam: proxy-alb-3 95th write latency peaked, TCP write backlog increased. Upstream backend responses look fine (model pods returning chunks), but proxy shows retry loops to backend (connection resets).
Jordan: oncall here, taking ownership. Quick triage checklist: 1) determine if proxy or client is the bottleneck 2) assess customer impact 3) apply mitigation (routing/fallback)
Elena: support: 4 customers in EU with streaming timeouts, 1 on Dedicated, rest on Hosted. No major revenue impact reported yet but timeouts hit interactive features. Customers submitted traces showing long pauses between chunks (~3s).
Maya: digging into metrics, noticed per-connection send_window shrink on proxy side + repeated EPIPE when proxy flushes. Suspect proxy write buffer/windowing interplay with client backpressure.
Liam: logs from proxy-alb-3:
```
proxy: stream_id=0x7f3a delay_ms=3200 write_retry=4 upstream_reset=true
proxy: net.write_queue_len=4820 keepalive=30s conn_reset_count=12
```
Jordan: mitigation plan: A) increase proxy keepalive and socket write buffer, B) scale proxy pool + drain suspect instance, C) activate regional fallback (route 25% EU traffic to us-west-2) D) if persists, enable streaming chunk coalescing on model runtime to avoid tiny writes.
Rahul: agreed. I'm going to start step A and C now. Scaling test: `kubectl scale deployment/proxy-alb --replicas=6 -n prod-eu` and modify configmap `proxy.socket.keepalive=120s`
Maya: also enable chunk coalescing feature flag for runtime (non-disruptive): `redwoodctl feature enable runtime.chunk_coalesce --env=prod --region=eu-west-1`
deploy-bot: configmap updated: proxy.socket.keepalive -> 120s by Rahul. Rolling config reload started for proxy-alb in prod-eu.
Jordan: Rahul — start the 25% traffic reroute via smart-routing and watch p99. Use canary policy, do not exceed 25%.
Rahul: routing change applied (smart-routing policy id sr-5346). Rerouting 25% -> us-west-2.
Elena: customer update draft sent to affected tenants (short note + we are mitigating).
Liam: after scaling one proxy instance drained and removed, new nodes show lower net.write_queue_len. p99 dropped to ~1.1s within 90s of scaling.
Maya: enabling coalescing reduced small write bursts. Observed chunk sizes increase slightly, fewer retries.
Jordan: good progress. Continue watch for 15m, keep routing in place for 10m, then step down to 5% if stable. If p99 < 800ms for 10m, mark mitigated.
Maya: current metrics 5m window: p95 360ms, p99 780ms, errors back to baseline 0.2%.
Elena: support: customers confirmed improvement for interactive flows. No new tickets in last 12m.
deploy-bot: rolling reload completed on proxy-alb (all pods restarted gracefully).
Jordan: moving to monitoring phase. Oncall handoff in 20m to Liam (overnight).
Liam: taking handoff at +20m. Will keep routing in place until morning if stability holds.
Jordan: summary for postmortem: Root cause likely proxy socket/windowing + client backpressure creating retry loops and write queue buildup. Actions: increase keepalive, scale proxy pool, enable chunk coalescing, add better telemetry on per-connection send_window. Follow-up: run synthetic long-tail streaming tests, add auto-scale triggers based on net.write_queue_len.
Maya: filing incident ticket with runbook notes and attaching traces.
Jordan: :thumbsup: closing paging call. Watch for regressions and add to retro.
